description: Joining the ‘Global Coalition for Social Justice’
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-15 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Global Coalition for Social Justice is an international voluntary initiative dedicated to fostering cooperation among government, employer-employee organizations, financial institutions and development banks, non-governmental organizations and academic sector for promoting social justice and a decent work environment. The said institution operates under the leadership of the International Labour Organization and is a social platform that can quickly find solutions to global social justice challenges. Accordingly, it has been recognized that joining the global forum will enable to make decisions pertaining to employer-employee related issues with a comprehensive understanding of contemporary global economic and social trends as well as to strengthen worker care services, increase female labour force participation, ensure the development of workers in the informal sector, and strengthen social security measures such as employee injury insurance of public and private sector, maternity and unemployment insurance. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Labour for the Ministry of Labour to join the Global Coalition for Social Justice’ as a partner organization on behalf of the Government of Sri Lanka, and for the Ministry in charge of the subject of Labour to operate as the focal point for Sri Lanka in that Coalition, was approved by the Cabinet.
